name: Gelatinous Cube — Additional Material (d20pfsrd)
body:
More on Gelatinous Cube from d20pfsrd.com.

These sections appear on d20pfsrd.com's pages "Gelatinous Cube (Ebony)", "Gelatinous Cube (Electric)", "Gelatinous Cube (Frost)" but are not part of the Gelatinous Cube entry, which is unchanged.

From d20pfsrd.com: Gelatinous Cube (Ebony)

ECOLOGY

Environment any underground
Organization solitary
Treasure incidental

As a product of magical experimentation, the gelatinous cube exists in several different varieties. This form is a gelatinous cube that has been crossed with a deadly black pudding. Vast cubes of inky slime, they lose their transparent ability, but their acid is more powerful, able to dissolve even metal.

From d20pfsrd.com: Gelatinous Cube (Electric)

Partially Transparent (Ex)

Unlike its more common transparent cousin, an electric gelatinous cube has a purplish sheen, making it somewhat easier to detect. A DC 10 Perception check is required to notice a motionless electric gelatinous cube. Any creature that fails to notice an electric gelatinous cube and walks into it is automatically engulfed.

ECOLOGY

Environment any underground
Organization solitary
Treasure incidental

This rare variant of gelatinous cube is capable of producing powerful electrical shocks.

From d20pfsrd.com: Gelatinous Cube (Frost)

hp 50 (4d8+32)
Fort +9, Ref –4, Will –4
Defensive Abilities fast healing 3 if within 5 ft. of fire
Immune electricity, ooze traits
Weaknesses cold vulnerability

OFFENSE

Speed 15 ft.
Melee slam +2 (1d6 plus 1d6 acid)
Space 10 ft.; Reach 5 ft.

Partially Transparent (Ex)

Unlike its more common transparent cousin, an electric gelatinous cube has a purplish sheen, making it somewhat easier to detect. A DC 10 Perception check is required to notice a motionless electric gelatinous cube. Any creature that fails to notice an electric gelatinous cube and walks into it is automatically engulfed.

ECOLOGY

Environment any underground
Organization solitary
Treasure incidental

This ooze contains floating pockets of symbiotic brown mold. In addition to eating whatever organic materials they pick up, frost cubes feed on warmth and radiate cold. Living creatures within 5 feet of the cube take 3d6 points of nonlethal cold damage per round. Fire brought within 5 feet of a frost cube gives it fast healing 3. It takes +50% damage from cold attacks.
